lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council session, where work sessions tackle the Comprehensive Plan, a Gondola Subcommittee update, and — most importantly — proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies, a process that could meaningfully shape who gets to stay in this canyon. Over in Ouray County on Wednesday, the Planning Commission meets virtually to work through possible changes to the Land Use Code's definitions section, which is the kind of quiet groundwork that determines what gets built and where. The week rounds out with a full slate of community events, including an emergency preparedness talk Monday and a Mountain Towns 2030 climate action discussion Wednesday.

notable.stake: Third-party audit of rental housing policies could reshape who stays in Telluride.
Land use code definition changes in Ouray County shape future development rules.
